adaptation_wait_notice: This table is still preparing a place the Keeper needed, so it could not take you there this turn. Nothing you did was lost — send anything to continue, and the Keeper picks it up once the preparation lands.
adaptation_ready_notice: The place the Keeper needed is ready now, so the next turn can take you there. Nothing you did was lost — say anything to go on.
commit_down_notice: This turn could not be saved: the table's history store has refused to write {streak} times in a row, so nothing can be recorded and no turn can be delivered until it is repaired. Nothing you did was lost, and the person running this table has been told what to fix.
delivery_cut_short_notice: The Keeper wrote this turn in two parts and the second was refused after the turn had already closed, so what you just read stops early. Everything already settled is kept — send anything and the Keeper picks it up from there.
empty_input_notice: That message had no text in it, so nothing reached the table. Say what you want to do.
kernel_table_failed: The kernel could not open the table: {detail}
play_help_1: Say what your investigator does or says, in your own words, one thing at a time.
play_help_2: When the outcome is uncertain the Keeper rolls the dice, and the roll appears as a card beside the words.
play_help_3: Ask “what is that?” whenever you like; an answer is never a penalty, and nothing you ask for is a wrong move.
provider_down_notice: The connection to the model has now dropped {streak} times in a row, the last after about {seconds}s with nothing returned. That wait was an outage, not the Keeper thinking, and the person running this table has been told.
provider_failed_notice: This turn could not finish because the connection to the model returned no result. Nothing you did was lost — send anything to continue.
provider_outage_notice: The connection to the model dropped during this turn: about {seconds}s of the wait returned nothing at all, and the request had to be made again. That was an outage, not the Keeper thinking, and nothing you did was lost.
resend_held_notice: That is the message the table is already working on, word for word, so it was not started a second time. The turn you sent it for is still running.
review_down_notice: This turn could not be published: its continuity review has failed {streak} times in a row. Everything already settled is kept, and sending again does start a fresh attempt — but if it keeps failing, pick a quicker model under Lane model in settings; the next review uses it without restarting this table. The person running this table has been told.
review_unavailable_notice: This turn could not be published: its continuity review did not finish. Everything already settled is kept — send anything to try again.
review_verdict_notice: This turn could not be published: the continuity review read it and did not approve it. Everything already settled is kept and still counts — send anything and the Keeper picks up from what happened here.
setup_complete: Setup complete. Open the table with: {command}
setup_guidance_review_failed: Character guidance review failed; retry preparation before continuing.
setup_help_1: You are making your investigator, the person you will play. Whoever is asking is part of the story, and what you answer becomes who that person is.
setup_help_2: A name and what they do for a living is enough to start. Say it in your own words, as if answering them.
setup_help_3: The host will ask two or three more questions, then build the character sheet for you. There are no rules to learn first.
setup_help_4: Once you confirm the sheet, the story goes on from this room, and whatever you type is what your investigator does or says.
setup_help_skip: You can say “make the card now” at any point to skip the questions.
setup_opened: Setup: {total} steps in all. Next step: {step}.
setup_packages_failed: The setup package context is unavailable: {detail}
source_wait_notice: Part of the source this table needs is still being read, so the Keeper could not use it this turn. Nothing you did was lost, and nothing else at the table is blocked — send anything to continue.
standing_condition_notice: {name} is {state} and takes no action of their own: anything you declare for them will be refused until the state lifts. The character sheet carries it too.
table_input_refused_notice: The table could not take that input. This is a fault at the table, not your wording — saying it again will fail the same way. Nothing moved: the story is exactly where it was, and the person running this table has been given the reason.
turn_unfinished_notice: This turn ended without a delivered result. Anything already settled is kept — send anything to continue.
